A section with item gives the vector for that single item. null means no knowledge supplied. Vector indices refer to facts in property order. defaults is the explicit complete three-index vector: append its trailing indices to a shorter vector; a scalar is a one-index vector. Only explicitly listed items use defaults. Each fact is [descriptor index, value]; each descriptor is [status, source, applicability index]. applicability records give applicability and its source. Applicability is independent of status; unknown never proves NA. measured: known value from that source; range: only that window/alternatives; unknown: no supported fact; not_applicable: explicit inapplicability.
